recipe.visualDefinition: A central square collage of four distinct vintage-style bar scenes, rendered with a watercolor-over-photo effect, set against a large, textured terracotta-red border. The imagery features groups of people in casual 1970s attire, with a hazy, dreamlike quality and visible paper grain.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square collage vs. expansive solid-color border
Muted, desaturated interior tones vs. vibrant terracotta frame
Loose watercolor linework vs. underlying photographic structure
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and paper texture throughout
Terracotta-red outer frame taking up 60% of the composition
Four-quadrant grid layout within the central square
Desaturated, warm-leaning color palette for the imagery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central square collage occupies the middle third of the frame, surrounded by a wide, uniform border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central square collage acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes land on the central collage, scan the four quadrants clockwise, then move upward to the subtle title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the thick, textured red border creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted cream and sepia (central image highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy and faded purple (clothing in the collage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation for the central imagery; high value contrast between dark shadows and blown-out highlights in the collage.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or greens

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rendered with very low opacity to blend into the background texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying opacity or scale to maintain a minimalist, archival look.
graphicDevices: Watercolor bleed edges on the central square

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the weathered, historical feel of the composition.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured terracotta-red background with heavy film grain. In the center, place a square collage of four vintage 1970s bar scenes. Apply a watercolor wash effect over the photos, using muted sepia, cream, and burgundy tones. The edges of the square should look slightly worn like an old printed photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in a classic serif font centered in the top margin. The text color should be a slightly darker shade of the background red with 30% opacity to look like a faint stamp or faded print.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the border and image?
Is the central collage perfectly square?
Is the text subtle enough to almost blend into the background?
Are the watercolor lines loose and expressive?

adjustableVariables: Border color (e.g., olive green or mustard yellow)
Number of quadrants in the collage
mustRedesign: Any specific faces from the original
Exact brand logos on beer bottles or signs
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible but extremely subtle.
Ensure the watercolor effect doesn't obscure the human figures entirely.
Verify the paper texture feels tactile and physical.
Confirm the red border is uniform in color but rich in texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square collage of [Subject: Vintage Social Scenes] + [Effect: Watercolor over Photo] + [Frame: Wide Textured Solid Color Border] + [Text: Low-Opacity Centered Serif]
